description: libfreenect2 is an open-source driver library for the Kinect for Windows v2 depth-sensing camera, exposing its color, infrared, and depth sensor streams through CPU, OpenGL, OpenCL, or CUDA processing pipelines. This JavaCPP Presets module generates Java bindings for the native libfreenect2 library, letting JVM applications capture and process Kinect v2 frames directly through JNI without writing custom native-interop code.
